contribution.position: On the reliability axis, the gateway is not in a healthy state to absorb change: the 30-day error rate of 1.8% sits six times above the 0.3% SLO, and two sev2 incidents in the same window indicate an already-degraded service. Even with a clean test report (412 passed, 0 failed, 87% coverage) and p99 within budget at peak load, those green signals measure the change in isolation, not the system's current error budget. Shipping into a service that is actively breaching its SLO risks compounding an existing reliability problem and makes attribution of any new errors harder.
